videos.title: Lam：鉬金屬化與 ALTUS Halo
watchFor: 互連縮小時需要重新評估材料，而非只縮小幾何。
鉬是此產品案例的材料；不能直接套用到銅、鈷、釕或鎢課程。
比較電阻、薄膜沉積與整合限制，分開供應商說明及自己的驗證。
watchForEn: Shrinking interconnects requires reconsidering material choices, not only geometry.
Molybdenum belongs to this product case; do not transfer it directly to copper, cobalt, ruthenium or tungsten lessons.
Compare resistance, deposition and integration constraints while separating vendor statements from your verification.
videos.scope: 本課「化學機械平坦化」的延伸背景。用鉬 ALD 案例比較金屬互連材料轉換；不是其他金屬的通用配方。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Chemical mechanical planarization. Use the molybdenum-ALD case to compare interconnect material transitions; it is not a universal recipe for other metals. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: ALTUS Halo: Ushering in the Molybdenum Era of Semiconductor Metallization
videos.originalTitle: ALTUS Halo: Ushering in the Molybdenum Era of Semiconductor Metallization
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「移除量與平坦度：建立模型」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「研磨墊狀態：建立模型」列為查證任務：墊表面演化會改變移除與均勻度；修整器磨耗也會改變墊狀態。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Pad condition: construct and analyze: Pad evolution changes removal and uniformity; Conditioner wear also changes pad state.

guides.title: 化學機械平坦化：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Chemical mechanical planarization: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「移除量與平坦度：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜移除量與平坦度：建立模型：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
觀察站 2｜研磨墊狀態：建立模型：墊表面演化會改變移除與均勻度；修整器磨耗也會改變墊狀態。
觀察站 3｜整合驗收：故障判讀與驗證：CMP 驗收必須連到後續整合要求；微影焦深需求與局部地形有關。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
Observation station 2 | Pad condition: construct and analyze: Pad evolution changes removal and uniformity; Conditioner wear also changes pad state.
Observation station 3 | Integration acceptance: diagnose and verify: CMP acceptance must connect to downstream integration; Lithographic focus needs depend on local topography.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「研磨墊狀態：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Pad condition: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只記累積片數而忽略墊狀態」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Recording wafer count while ignoring pad state", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

courses.overview: 從「化學機械平坦化」延伸比較CMP 漿料與磨粒控制、銅雙鑲嵌互連：先區分量測量與失效機制，再判斷哪些原理可轉用、哪些條件必須重新驗證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Chemical mechanical planarization by comparing CMP slurry and abrasive control and Copper dual-damascene interconnects: distinguish measurands and failure mechanisms before deciding what transfers and what needs fresh validation.

related.transfer: CMP 的去除率與刮傷需同時追查磨粒族群、化學活性及墊面接觸。
related.transferEn: CMP removal and scratching require joint analysis of abrasive populations, chemistry and pad contact.
related.difference: 平坦化課看晶圓高度與膜厚分布；漿料課看粒徑尾端、濃度及老化。單靠平均粒徑不能預測整片平坦度。
related.differenceEn: Planarization measures wafer height and thickness; slurry control examines particle tails, concentration and aging. Mean size alone cannot predict planarity.
practice: 畫出漿料批次到膜厚與刮傷的因果假說。
比較濾前後大粒尾端及有效磨粒濃度。
設計固定墊況的分批試驗，保留空白取樣。
practiceEn: Map hypotheses from slurry lots to thickness and scratches.
Compare large-particle tails and useful abrasive concentration before and after filtering.
Design a split with fixed pad condition and sampling blanks.
related.title: CMP 漿料與磨粒控制

related.transfer: 雙鑲嵌填銅後須去除表面多餘金屬；CMP 的凹陷與侵蝕會改變互連截面。
related.transferEn: After damascene copper fill, CMP removes overburden; dishing and erosion alter interconnect cross-sections.
related.difference: 填銅重點是孔槽覆蓋與空洞；CMP 重點是選擇性去除與終點。拋光不能修復已埋入的填孔空洞。
related.differenceEn: Fill targets feature coverage and voids; CMP targets selective removal and endpoint. Polishing cannot repair buried fill voids.
practice: 依序畫溝槽、填銅與去除過厚層。
比較相同線寬但不同凹陷的有效截面。
將空洞與凹陷分配到不同量測及改善模組。
practiceEn: Draw trenches, copper fill and overburden removal in order.
Compare effective areas at equal linewidth but different dishing.
Assign voids and dishing to different measurements and corrective modules.

courses.summary: 本課以「NIST 量測研究參考園區」作為公開研究、量測或產業歷史的代表地點。從移除量與平坦度、碟陷與侵蝕到整合驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。 技術由多個地區、企業與研究團隊共同發展；地圖不是唯一發明地，也不是未公開生產設施定位。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses NIST metrology-research reference campus as a public research, metrology or industrial-history reference. From Removal versus planarity and Dishing and erosion to Integration acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages. Multiple regions and institutions develop these technologies; the map is neither an exclusive invention claim nor undisclosed production coordinates.
